repo.name: Yōkai
repo.description: The F-Droid repository for Yōkai and Yōkai Nightly, a free and open source manga reader for Android

application.name: Yōkai
application.desc:
Yōkai is a free and open source manga reader for Android, forked from Tachiyomi/Mihon. It ships without any content and only talks to the sources you install yourself, everything you download can be read offline afterwards.
Features:
• Reading of downloaded content, local sources read ComicInfo.xml for the chapter title, number and scanlator. • NSFW/SFW library filters, categories and tags. • A configurable reader with multiple viewers, reading directions and per series settings. • Trackers for MyAnimeList, AniList, Kitsu, Manga Updates, Shikimori and Bangumi. • Scheduled library updates and local backups. • Material You themes, a staggered library grid, drag and drop sorting and dynamic categories.
Requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer.
Extensions are not part of this repository. They are downloaded from the extension repository built into the app, and every source you add determines where the app connects to. Many of them are not free services, which is why the app is tagged with the NonFreeNet anti-feature.
This build is upstream's "standard" flavour, so it contains the proprietary Firebase and Google Play services libraries, hence the GooglePlay anti-feature. It is not a build from the F-Droid build service.
application.author: null2264

application.name: Yōkai Nightly
application.desc:
Nightly builds of Yōkai, the free and open source manga reader for Android. Rebuilt from the development branch on every upstream commit, so expect bugs that the stable releases do not have. Back up your library before switching to a nightly and before updating it again.
Because this is a nightly, it is installed under its own package name next to the stable app rather than replacing it. The two installs do not share a database: a library built up in one is not visible in the other.
Features are the same as the stable release: reading of downloaded content, local sources that read ComicInfo.xml, NSFW/SFW library filters, multiple readers and reading directions, trackers for MyAnimeList, AniList, Kitsu, Manga Updates, Shikimori and Bangumi, categories, backups and Material You themes.
Requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer.
Extensions are not part of this repository. They are downloaded from the extension repository built into the app, and every source you add determines where the app connects to. Many of them are not free services, which is why the app is tagged with the NonFreeNet anti-feature.
These builds are upstream's "standard" flavour, so they contain the proprietary Firebase and Google Play services libraries, hence the GooglePlay anti-feature. They are not builds from the F-Droid build service.
Report problems on the main repository, not on the nightly one: https://github.com/null2264/yokai/issues
